tooling.message:
feat(guidance): exercise patterns in Explore, before the archetype; evals: no crash on a dangling symlink, commit and listing skills after the scenario's end

## Intent

The exercise patterns show what kind of practice a subject needs, and that points to the archetype. Agents read them in Explore anyway, so the process should use them there, before the archetype is chosen. The second eval run also showed two flaws in the measure: the score crashed on a dangling symlink, and it expected the commit and listing skills, which come after the point where the simulated creator stops.

## Key changes

- The plan has the agent read the exercise patterns in Explore, after the goal and the learners; the kind of practice points to the archetype, and the template's README decides. Plan chooses a pattern per competency from them.
- The skill says how the kind of practice leads to the archetype; lernapps-app points to it for the choice; the increment template loads it in Explore too. Its building block moves to the Explore skills.
- The verifier skips an entry it cannot read, such as a dangling symlink, instead of crashing.
- The fresh tasks expect the commit and listing skills only when the scenario reaches them.
- The conclusions of run 2 mark both actions as done and drop the action to force the commit and listing skills.

tooling.message:
fix(evals): see the phase a sed, a one-liner or a helper script sets; run 2's early creates read in the transcripts

## Intent

Run 2 counted many more apps as created before the creator confirmed the plan. The score took the first phase a command named, which in a sed is the old value, and did not see a helper script outside the plan folder at all. So the plan counted as unconfirmed and every create as early.

## Key changes

- The score takes the last phase a command or a write names, and the phase the template's grep prints.
- A create in the turn that sets phase: code still counts as after the confirmation, because the creator's message opens that turn.
- The conclusions of run 2 record what the transcripts show: 7 of 13 early creates were gaps in the measure, 6 were real, 5 of them after a yes to an early draft. A new open action: only the yes at the Plan checkpoint lets the agent run create.
